en: Red Phoenix: The Chaos Urn sits inside the Four Symbols Godslayer Array. The souls of the Four Symbols that built it were drawn into the Urn to control the array. Return the four souls to their places and the array will fail. You still need the Turtle Orb - sadly I can't go with you to find it. Even out of control, the Urn can drain the soul of anyone who enters, so you'll need the Heart Lamp to protect you.
Red Phoenix: I have a move called "Dragon Grab". I hope it serves you well.
